name: Sergeant Brant
title: Waykeeper Sergeant
examine: Youngest sergeant on the marches — promoted the night the fork waystation held against Redmask Orla's crew. Still writes his mother that it's quiet out here.
lines: Redmask's crew tried the fork twice. There isn't going to be a third — she counts as well as we do.
See a lamp burning where no lamp should be? Old line tower. Shelter by day. LEAVE by dusk.
It is quiet out here. Between things.
